# jira_permission_scheme_grant (Resource)

Manages a permission grant within a Jira permission scheme. Each grant assigns a specific permission to a holder (user, group, role, etc.).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "jira_permission_scheme" "editors" {
  name        = "Project Editors"
  description = "Permission scheme for project editors"
}

resource "jira_group" "developers" {
  name = "developers"
}

// Grant BROWSE_PROJECTS to a group
resource "jira_permission_scheme_grant" "browse" {
  scheme_id        = jira_permission_scheme.editors.id
  permission       = "BROWSE_PROJECTS"
  holder_type      = "group"
  holder_parameter = jira_group.developers.name
}

// Grant ADMINISTER_PROJECTS to the project lead
resource "jira_permission_scheme_grant" "admin" {
  scheme_id   = jira_permission_scheme.editors.id
  permission  = "ADMINISTER_PROJECTS"
  holder_type = "projectLead"
}

// Grant CREATE_ISSUES to a specific role
resource "jira_role" "developers_role" {
  name        = "Developers"
  description = "Development team role"
}

resource "jira_permission_scheme_grant" "create_issues" {
  scheme_id        = jira_permission_scheme.editors.id
  permission       = "CREATE_ISSUES"
  holder_type      = "projectRole"
  holder_parameter = jira_role.developers_role.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `scheme_id` (String) ID of the permission scheme
- `permission` (String) The permission to grant (e.g. BROWSE_PROJECTS, CREATE_ISSUES, ADMINISTER_PROJECTS)
- `holder_type` (String) The type of the permission holder (e.g. group, user, projectRole, projectLead, assignee, reporter, applicationRole)

### Optional

- `holder_parameter` (String) The parameter for the holder type (e.g. group name, user key, role ID). Not required for types like projectLead, assignee, reporter.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax (scheme_id/grant_id):

```shell
terraform import jira_permission_scheme_grant.example 12345/67890
```
